summary: Iteration 9: tested the utilization API, the Dashboard utilization card and the SignaturePad theme switch. Everything passed. Backend: 15/15 new pytest tests passed, and the full suite passed (71). Frontend: Playwright checks of the Dashboard card in DE/EN, light/dark and at 390px wide. Also checked the signature pad pixels across theme toggles, a handover submit, and the tab regression. No page errors.

issues: The amber-400 idle badge and percent text have low contrast on the #FAFAFA card. Consider amber-600 in light mode.
Future-day cells (bg-white/[0.02]) are almost invisible in light mode. Acceptable, but the strip end is hard to see.

critical_code_review_comments: UtilizationCard: while loading or on API error, data is null, so the card shows util-empty 'No vehicles yet'. This is misleading. Add separate loading and error states.

UtilizationCard: the current month and next-button disabling use the browser's local date (new Date()). The backend uses Europe/Berlin. Near midnight on a month boundary, a user outside Berlin could request a 'future' month and get a 400, which shows as empty.
_trip_ranges loads all handovers on every request (to_list(100000)) without a date filter. Fine for now, but add a created_at filter (or a filter on return >= first) as data grows.
SignaturePad: strokes are kept only on theme change. A window resize/orientation change does not repaint (pre-existing behaviour, not in scope).
seed_data_creation: A temporary vehicle TEST_UI9 (TEST-UI9) with protocols TEST_UI9_h1/r1/h2 (an Oct 5-14 trip and an open handover since Nov 2). Also a UI handover protocol, driver TEST_SigDriver. All of it was deleted by id afterwards. Seed vehicles MB Vito and VW T-Roc were not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Utilization endpoint verified: Berlin-day conversion (23:30 UTC -> next day), inclusive ranges, open handover until today, month clipping, overlap de-duplication, sorting, and 400s for abc/2026-13/2026/2026-00/''/future. Missing param gives 422. The UI showed TEST row 3/4 days = 75% (Nov) and 10/31 = 32% (Oct), with idle badges on the 0% vehicles. Next is disabled on the current month. The 390px layout has no overflow (scrollWidth 390). Signature check: sample the canvas with getImageData and take the dominant colour = bg (10,10,10 dark / 255,255,255 light). Strokes are 24,24,27 in light and white in dark, and stay visible after each toggle. Clear after a toggle works, with no ghost strokes after the next toggle. The submit after a toggle returned 200 with signature_base64, and the pads reset. Handover endpoint: POST /api/protocols/handover with signature_base64. Theme via settings-menu-trigger -> theme-light/theme-dark. Run ui_seed_it9.py seed/clean for UI data.
